notes.content:
This release contains some performance improvements, as well as some suggested improvements from users. These include:

- Level 23 bug fixed where you didn't need the purple dream shard
- Hiding Swap Icon on Level 2
- UI improvements

notes.title: Poly Vita Has Achievements!
notes.content:
After giving it some thought and considering the value that many players on Steam place on achievements, I have decided to add them to Poly Vita! 

Achievements will enhance the gameplay experience by adding an extra layer of challenge. 
For those who are up for a real puzzle challenge, try going for the  [b]Path Master[/b] achievement!

[b]Path Master[/b]
